title: Seller Performance Standing Step-Down Share for Serious Violations, by Level
content:
**Share.** The step-down share is the high step-down share of 0.2 (20%) for a seller placed at Above Standard Level, Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level with no more than one serious violation recorded in the last twelve whole calendar months, and the middle step-down share of 0.15 (15%) for a seller placed at Standard Level, Developing Seller Level or Below Standard Level with no more than one serious violation recorded in that period. A seller with two or more serious violations recorded in that period takes neither of these shares.

Serious violations, for the Seller Performance Standing step-down, are intellectual property, inauthentic complaint, product authenticity and review manipulation violations. A violation lies in the last twelve whole calendar months when fewer than twelve whole months have passed from its recording date to the handling date, counted by calendar date.

## Matrix

| Level placed at | Serious violations in the last twelve whole calendar months | Step-down share |
|---|---|---|
| Above Standard Level, Top Rated Level, Preferred Partner Level | 0 or 1 | 0.2 |
| Standard Level, Developing Seller Level, Below Standard Level | 0 or 1 | 0.15 |
| any level | 2 or more | neither share above |

## Boundary and examples (hypothetical)

- An Above Standard Level seller with exactly one serious violation in the period: 0.2. With a second serious violation in the period: neither 0.2 nor 0.15.
- A Standard Level seller with one serious violation recorded eleven whole months ago and another recorded thirteen whole months ago: only the first is in the period, so 0.15.
- Listing policy and restricted product violations do not enter the count.
- Carried points of 8 multiplied by 0.2 give 1.6000; multiplied by 0.15 they give 1.2000.
